notes: Clauses about life span, death, named diseases and physical defects are omitted under the sensitive-topics policy; affected rules list them in 'dropped'.

skipped.reason: Death of the spouse and its timing: excluded by policy.
Descriptions of sexual partners and of the spouse's body and fidelity: not suitable for a report.
Age at marriage: the text gives ages from the 5th year on, reflecting child marriage; not meaningful today.

rules.text: The 7th lord in its own or exalted sign: full happiness through the spouse.
The 7th lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th and not in its own or exalted sign: the spouse's health needs care.
Venus in the 7th house: very strong desires.

variants.text: A strong 7th lord with benefic influence: wealthy, honoured, happy and fortunate.
A weak, debilitated, combust or enemy-sign 7th lord: the spouse's health needs care and more than one marriage is indicated.

rules.text: The 7th lord in a sign of Saturn or Venus with a benefic aspect, or exalted: more than one marriage or relationship is indicated.
The Moon in the 7th, the 7th lord in the 12th and a weak Venus: little happiness through the spouse.
Mars and Venus in the 7th, Saturn in the 7th with the ascendant lord in the 8th, or a debilitated 7th lord with a malefic: more than one marriage is indicated.
